# cli.inspect_cli { #healpyxel.cli.inspect_cli }

```python
cli.inspect_cli(argv=None)
```

CLI entry point for healpyxel_inspect.

Defines the ``healpyxel_inspect`` command for inspecting and
visualising pipeline results.  Invokes
:func:`healpyxel.inspect.parse_arguments` then
:func:`healpyxel.inspect.run`.

New flags (ADR-018):
- ``--geometry`` — show geometry column discovery info (GEO metadata,
  encoding, geometry types, bbox, sidecar compatibility).
- ``--correct-geometry OUTPUT.parquet`` — rewrite the input with corrected
  GeoParquet metadata (decodes WKB, sets EPSG:4326 CRS via geopandas).
  One-time fix to eliminate per-run WKB decode overhead.
- ``--force`` — overwrite output without prompting (used with
  ``--correct-geometry``).

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type                | Description                                                 | Default   |
|--------|---------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| argv   | list\[str\] or None | Argument list (defaults to ``sys.argv[1:]`` when ``None``). | `None`    |
